title: AI Seeds
subtitle: AI literacy for the real world
description: Build a clear mental model of modern AI, from training data and neural networks to generative tools, limitations, safety, and the choices people make around them.
audience: Curious beginners, leaders, students, and career changers
prerequisites: None. Just curiosity and a willingness to question the hype.
topics: Human judgement in an AI world
outcomes: Explain how modern AI systems learn and generate outputs
Choose AI tools with clear expectations and boundaries
Spot common reliability, bias, privacy, and safety risks
Complete a guided AI experiment and reflect on its limits
